warn_body: Privacy features work only on your side and don't guarantee 100% protection. Use them as an extra layer of confidentiality.

prevent_typing.title: Don't show «typing»
prevent_typing.desc: The other person won't see you typing

blur_on_unfocus.title: Blur on leave
blur_on_unfocus.desc: Blur the page when the cursor leaves the VK window

panic.title: Instantly hide all dialogs
panic.desc: Hide all dialogs with a single hotkey

online.title: Hide online status
online.no_token: Open a VK tab — API access is needed to change the status

hidden.title: Hidden dialogs
hidden.subtitle: Hide chats from the list
hidden.intro: The selected dialogs won't appear in the chat list — no name, no avatar, no messages. The conversation won't be lost, it just becomes invisible.
hidden.empty_hint: Click «Add» — the dialog will disappear from the chat list

crypto.title: Message encryption
crypto.subtitle: Format, marker and key
crypto.enable_desc: A button in the VK input box; incoming messages are decrypted automatically
crypto.marker_note: The ciphertext is the same for all markers — different VK clients use different wrappers. Decryption automatically understands all four.
crypto.tip: A {{emoji}} button will appear in the VK input box. Click it before sending — the text will be replaced with ciphertext. Incoming messages in the COFFEE and VKify E2E formats are decrypted automatically.

COFFEE.compat: Kate Mobile · VK Coffee · Laney · Vika
COFFEE.key_hint: Without a key, the protocol's public key is used, compatible with Kate Mobile and VK Coffee by default.
COFFEE.key_placeholder: Leave empty for compatibility with Kate Mobile / VK Coffee…

VKify.key_hint: The password must match on the sender and recipient sides. Without a password, VKify encryption is unavailable.
